query: query ($ids: [Int], $since: Int, $until: Int) { Page(perPage: 50) { media(id_in: $ids) { id status episodes nextAiringEpisode { episode airingAt } } } recent: Page(perPage: 50) { airingSchedules(mediaId_in: $ids, airingAt_greater: $since, airingAt_lesser: $until, sort: TIME_DESC) { mediaId episode airingAt } } }
